{{Quote|I was once an accomplished adventurer. I scoured the galaxy looking for fame and fortune. But it all came crashing down.|Riyan Kiner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />}}
'''Riyan Kiner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] adventurer turned [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Crates?!!? I hate 'em! Worse thing that ever happened to the universe. And did you know that there are people mass producing them! I could not believe it. When I found out, I knew that I had to take action. These crate makers must be stopped!!|Riyan Kiner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />}}
Riyan Kiner was once an accomplished adventurer, albeit mentally unstable. He spent his life searching for fabled artifacts such as the [[Force crystal of Naga Sadow]] or the [[Journals of Ood Bnar]]. After searching crates for years, Kiner fostered an intense hatred of crates and finally gave up his career. He retired on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and lived in a small [[Riyan Kiner's Hovel|hovel]] outside [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Riyan Kiner was still utterly insane about crates and attacked the [[Joben Crate Company]], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] crate-manufacturing company owned by [[Talan Joben]]. Furthermore, he planted bombs at [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and threatened even more carnage if the production of crates should continue. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] investigating the attack of the crate company for ''[[Corellia Times]]'' reporter [[Vani Korr]] found a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with Riyan Kiner's threatening message. The adventurer located all the bombs and disarmed them just in time. The spacer also found evidence that led to the culprit of these terrorist attempts. The spacer tracked the retired explorer to his hovel, and Riyan Kiner was eventually killed in the confrontation.<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Riyan Kiner was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Riyan Kiner was added to the game with the update "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>

This NPC was known in the game as '''Riyan Kiner''' or '''Kiyan Riner''', depending of the Combat Level (CL) of the player. If the player performed the quest "[[W:c:swg:The Meatlumps Hideout|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 1]]" during the leveling of their character (at CL 65), the NPC would be named Riyan Kiner. If the player performed the quest after the end of the game (at CL 90), the NPC would be named Kiyan Riner. Multiple story elements indicated that the quest was intended to be achieved at CL 65.<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />
